verdict.rationale: Firebase ships its own natural-language surfaces. Gemini in Firebase offers a natural-language chat interface in the console and generates schemas, queries and mutations from natural language. The official Firebase MCP server lets AI editors create and manage projects, manage Auth users and work with Firestore data. However, hands-on operation via natural language depends on a third-party MCP client, and the in-console Gemini is documented mainly for answers, code generation and troubleshooting rather than executing operational commands. missing for 10: documented first-party natural-language execution of operations directly in the console (not just Q&A/generation), coverage of NL control across all products (e.g., deploys, hosting, functions), independent or hands-on corroboration of NL operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: shorten your troubleshooting process with new insights from Gemini in Firebase using a natural-language chat interface in the Firebase console
Use Gemini in Firebase to generate schemas, queries, and mutations on-demand using natural language.

An editor configured to use the Firebase MCP server can use its AI capabilities to help you: Create and manage Firebase projects, Manage your Firebase Authentication users, Work with data in Cloud Firestore and Firebase SQL Connect
The Firebase MCP server works with any tool that can act as an MCP client, including: Antigravity, Claude Code and Claude Desktop, Cline, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Windsurf, and more!
